name: Kast clean-slate delivery graph with durable topology
authority: Normative task graph paired with kast-clean-slate-plan.md. CanonicalOperationDefinitions generates the installed operation registry.

waves.3: Exact read authority and explicit durable topology

tasks.title: Encode target module roles and firewall
tasks.scope: Define target module roles, allowed dependency edges, effect owners, and forbidden references.
tasks.internal: Gradle convention plugins and verification tasks.

red.expected: Fails because the current graph contains modules and edges outside the target policy.

green.expected: Passes for the target skeleton; injected forbidden edge/effect fixtures reject.

tasks.title: Delete Rust completely
tasks.scope: Remove Rust code, Cargo state, Rust-owned artifacts, CI/release paths, binaries, compatibility state, TOON, kastctl, hooks, raw developer RPC, direct SQLite CLI access, and Rust documentation authority.
tasks.publicInterface: The Rust product interface ceases to exist.
tasks.internal: No Rust artifact is retained as fixture, benchmark, oracle, or fallback.

red.expected: Rejects an injected tracked Rust product root, Cargo manifest, source, or retained binary.

green.expected: Passes with zero Rust product ownership or retained binary.

tasks.title: Establish kernel outcome and proof types
tasks.scope: Define named root, generation, budgets, evidence envelopes, closed outcomes, closed failures, and capability marker types.
tasks.publicInterface: Kernel types used by all contract modules.
tasks.internal: Pure constructors and proof transitions only.

red.expected: Fails while invalid canonical states remain representable.

green.expected: All kernel invariants pass and kernel has no platform dependency.

tasks.title: Establish sole public operation registry and wire contract
tasks.scope: Define exactly twelve operation IDs, typed request/result bindings, generated serializers, schema identity, the registry-owned typed projection and wire-encoded operation-registry.json artifact, and the wire envelope.
tasks.internal: Generated serializer tables and route metadata.

red.expected: Fails until every operation has exactly one typed request, result, capability, effect, cost, schema binding, and generated registry entry.

green.expected: Round-trip and uniqueness tests pass for all twelve operations and all outcome variants; the generated registry equals CanonicalOperationDefinitions.

tasks.title: Build runtime server without platform dependencies
tasks.scope: Dispatch typed wire requests to typed operation bindings without IntelliJ, Gradle, JDBC, source writers, or aggregate backend authority.
tasks.internal: Typed binding table.

red.expected: Fails if server requires platform implementation or aggregate authority.

green.expected: Fake dispatch proves all outcome states and contract-only classpath.

tasks.title: Build Kotlin CLI boundary and exact-root runtime admission
tasks.scope: Implement command parsing, canonical root discovery, exact-root indexer demand, UDS client, JSON output, and exhaustive exit status.
tasks.publicInterface: Single kast executable and twelve command projections.
tasks.internal: Process adapter, socket client, output projector.

red.expected: Fails until workspace.inspect travels through the typed wire contract.

green.expected: CLI/native transport passes with no semantic/JDBC dependency and no fallback executable.

tasks.title: Publish one canonical workspace state
tasks.scope: Implement canonical-root admission, event-driven invalidation, reconciliation, immutable publication, coverage, and one generation-bound read lease.
tasks.internal: VFS observation, Gradle model port, candidate capture, delta classification, publication transaction.

red.expected: Fails when a moving workspace can publish Ready or mixed generations can be observed.

green.expected: Publication is atomic; movement discards candidate; prior generation survives failure.

tasks.title: Preserve Gradle source-root provenance
tasks.scope: Convert Gradle model roots directly to Authored, Generated, or Unknown and preserve source-set ownership.
tasks.internal: Gradle model classification adapter.

red.expected: Fails when path inference remains or raw root Paths escape the bridge.

green.expected: Every admitted source root carries model-derived provenance; Unknown stays explicit.

tasks.title: Implement bounded symbol discovery
tasks.scope: Implement index-backed, scope-compiled, bounded discovery returning detached candidates.
tasks.internal: SymbolCompilerPort and IntelliJ search adapter.

red.expected: Fails for collision fixtures or unbounded result work.

green.expected: Candidates are detached, bounded, generation-bound; bounds produce Qualified.

tasks.title: Implement exact selector refinement
tasks.scope: Refine a candidate selector into one compiler-grounded SymbolSelector bound to root and generation.
tasks.internal: Selector issuer and compiler resolution port.

red.expected: Fails when overloads collapse or stale selectors remain accepted.

green.expected: Exact selectors round-trip and stale selectors reject.

tasks.title: Implement one-hop semantic relations
tasks.scope: Implement closed live one-hop K2 relation meanings with exact occurrence, provenance, coverage, and continuation. relation.read does not require or build durable topology.
tasks.internal: RelationCompilerPort.

red.expected: Fails if relation meaning is ambiguous or incomplete coverage can report absence.

green.expected: Supported relation families return exact detached facts and qualified incomplete coverage.

tasks.title: Build explicit durable topology snapshots
tasks.scope: Expose topology.build as the twelfth operation. Enumerate only PublishedWorkspace source roots, extract detached K2 facts, publish only complete generation-bound SQLite coverage, reuse eligible snapshots, and keep current graph algorithms internal until bounded read operations exist.
tasks.publicInterface: topology.build plus topology snapshot/build contracts. No public zero-budget graph algorithms.
tasks.internal: Source-root enumeration, file-local K2 extraction, complete-coverage admission, atomic SQLite publication, snapshot eligibility, and internal graph indexes.

red.expected: Fails while topology is implicit, incomplete coverage can publish, restart reuse is unproven, the installed journey omits topology, or graph algorithms escape the stable contract.

green.expected: Publish, reuse, restart, staleness, rebuild rollback, corruption rejection, internal graph determinism, scale, and installed lifecycle proofs pass without hidden construction.

tasks.title: Implement pure bounded traversal
tasks.scope: Compose bounded traversal over an eligible durable topology-backed one-hop reader under explicit scope and resource bounds. Missing or stale topology rejects with an explicit build prerequisite.
tasks.internal: Pure traversal engine and OneHopRelationReader port.

red.expected: Fails on cycle, deterministic ordering, bound, stale snapshot, missing snapshot, or hidden-build fixtures.

green.expected: Deterministic fixtures pass; bounds qualify; missing or stale topology requires topology.build; the traversal service has no platform dependency.

tasks.title: Implement generation-bound diagnostics
tasks.scope: Read exact-scope compiler diagnostics against one semantic generation.
tasks.internal: DiagnosticCompilerPort.

red.expected: Fails if diagnostics can refresh or cross generation.

green.expected: Diagnostics are detached, scope-bound, generation-bound, and read-only.

tasks.title: Refine editable mutation targets
tasks.scope: Refine target roots and semantic targets into write-capable values only when provenance, ownership, containment, and state are proven.
tasks.internal: Pure admission transitions.

red.expected: Generated, unknown, escaped, ambiguous, stale, or wrong-owner targets incorrectly pass.

green.expected: Every invalid predicate has a distinct closed failure and only the returned capability enters planning.

tasks.title: Build pure change planning
tasks.scope: Plan AddDeclaration from exact inputs, detached evidence, deterministic obligations, planned edits, and expected semantic delta. Required topology absence and required traversal incompleteness remain distinct.
tasks.internal: Pure plan construction and obligation derivation.

red.expected: Fails when planning can mutate, build topology, omit obligations, depend on enumeration order, or accept incomplete required evidence.

green.expected: Equivalent inputs produce equivalent plan identity; source-write and topology-build code are absent from the planning path.

tasks.title: Establish durable mutation journal and recovery
tasks.scope: Persist pre-write recovery state, applied write sets, terminal recovery state, and tamper-evident plan binding.
tasks.internal: SQLite journal and recovery state machine.

red.expected: Crash fixtures expose a state that can be mistaken for success or cannot determine recovery.

green.expected: Every injected interruption ends as prior state, RolledBack, or RecoveryRequired.

tasks.title: Apply one short IntelliJ mutation
tasks.scope: Revalidate plan and source state, issue MutationAuthority, execute only admitted mutation, and return AppliedUnverified.
tasks.internal: Mutation admission service and IntelliJ SourceWriter.

red.expected: Wrong-root, stale, changed-content, out-of-scope, generated-target, or unplanned writes can reach mutation.

green.expected: Only exact admitted writes occur; faults rollback/recover; successful apply is AppliedUnverified.

tasks.title: Publish resulting generation and verify
tasks.scope: Reconcile after application, publish a distinct generation, re-evaluate obligations and expected semantic delta, and issue VerifiedReceipt only on complete proof.
tasks.internal: Obligation evaluator and semantic delta comparator.

red.expected: Applied source can report success without a distinct resulting generation or with unmet obligations.

green.expected: VerifiedReceipt requires final generation, coverage, diagnostics, discharged obligations, and accepted delta.

tasks.title: Expand change intents vertically
tasks.scope: Add RenameSymbol, AddFile, and ReplaceDeclaration one at a time through the existing plan/apply/verify protocol.
tasks.publicInterface: No new operation IDs; new closed ChangeIntent variants become supported.
tasks.internal: Intent-specific pure planner and narrow IntelliJ primitive.

red.expected: Each new intent begins with one focused failing semantic fixture.

green.expected: Each intent passes exact-target, unrelated-code, stale-state, rollback, and resulting-proof fixtures.

tasks.title: Delete legacy JVM aggregates
tasks.scope: Delete legacy aggregate contracts, transport, store ownership, AnalysisBackend, and compatibility routing.
tasks.publicInterface: Only the target twelve-operation contract remains.
tasks.internal: Composition wires operation contracts directly to services/adapters.

red.expected: Fails while any legacy module, AnalysisBackend symbol, compatibility route, or legacy authority remains.

green.expected: No legacy module/symbol remains and full target graph builds.

tasks.title: Prove installed Kotlin product
tasks.scope: Build, package, install, start the exact-root runtime, expose the exact twelve-operation schema, publish and reuse topology, traverse across restart, perform a verified mutation, reject stale topology, rebuild, and traverse the new generation.
tasks.internal: Native-image configuration and package assembly.

red.expected: Fails until a clean fixture executes the target product, exposes twelve exact operations, and constructs topology before required traversal and planning.

green.expected: The installed product proves topology publish, reuse, restart reuse, verified mutation, stale-snapshot rejection, complete rebuild, and new-generation traversal without a fallback artifact.

tasks.title: Enterprise correctness and failure acceptance
tasks.scope: Prove multi-module scale, event storms, checkout movement, exact overload identity, bounded traversal, topology scale and corruption rejection, crash recovery, stale selector/continuation rejection, and output bounds.
tasks.publicInterface: Acceptance behavior of the installed product.
tasks.internal: Enterprise-shaped fixtures, deterministic fault injection, benchmarks.

red.expected: Fails on any unproven scale or fault invariant.

green.expected: Correctness, topology durability, fault, security, determinism, architecture, and measured performance bounds pass together.
